answer: Payout is a dated option, not a balance. Work attested in epoch N mints a claim worth face only at N+8; cashing early sells it at a protocol Dutch auction opening at 55% of face and rising six points an epoch, discount to the buyer. Claims are bearer paper, so impatience has a price. Each operator picks a cost: freeze capital eight epochs per key, or give strangers nearly half of each claim - buyers who then own its output and can attach it once a sibling key is slashed. A thousand clones of one sonnet about the same reef pay both; one pearl of real attested work just waits and collects face.
